name: t_inhale_score
trained_on: operator file-name labels, one delivered AI-narrated audiobook (41 chapters) ch. 001-003, 150 ms floor applied; 27 T-inhale vs 506 other (plain breath, consonant-then-inhale, not-breath, unknown); 3 'possible' T-inhales excluded
held_out_at_threshold: top 27 in unseen chapters: 15/27 T-inhales, 56% of flags
label_caveat: labels made from out-of-context excerpts; T-inhale vs consonant-then-inhale is the least reliable distinction
